title: MOS post-spike mean reversion (short 4d)
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] MOS close 20d z-score > 1 (post-spike price level) leads MOS log returns by 2 days (-) as fertilizer equity rallies mean-revert; fade with short MOS 4d [finance.MOS.close -> finance.MOS.log_return]
message: Not supported: shorting MOS after a 20d z>1 price spike loses (41 trades, hit 44%, avg -0.72%/trade; OOS war hit 39%, avg -1.34%) - spikes continue rather than mean-revert; actionability 0.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.MOS.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short MOS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] MOS close 20d z-score > 1 leads MOS log returns by 2 days (+) as fertilizer momentum persists rather than mean-reverts (reversal of R2-0056 short rule); trade long MOS 3d [finance.MOS.close -> finance.MOS.log_return] (parent: R2-0056)
